meta.title: A Clear Explanation in Three Steps

scenes.purpose: Introduce the problem of an explanation that feels confusing.
scenes.narration: A complicated idea can feel difficult when every detail arrives at once.

visual.composition: A centered rounded interface panel contains several overlapping topic cards. A small illustrated guide sits at the edge and points toward the clutter, but remains visually secondary.

motion: Three cards enter with small staggered offsets and briefly overlap.
The guide character makes one short pointing gesture; the card group settles.
scenes.audio: Narration over a quiet rhythmic music bed; one soft UI tick as the cards appear.
scenes.transitionOut: The cards align into a clean horizontal sequence.

scenes.narration: Start with the main question, show the idea with a clear visual, then end with one takeaway.

visual.composition: Three equal interface cards sit on a horizontal grid. Each card contains one large icon, a short title, and a connecting line that makes the order obvious.

motion: The connecting line draws from left to right.
Each card rises into place as its narration phrase begins.
The active card brightens while the other two remain visible.
scenes.audio: A restrained UI tick accompanies each card entrance.
scenes.transitionOut: The three cards compress into one summary panel.

scenes.purpose: Reinforce the method and close the explanation.
scenes.narration: One question, one clear visual, and one memorable takeaway make the idea easier to follow.

visual.composition: A large summary panel displays the three compact steps as a single organized row. The small guide character appears in a corner as a brief closing accent.

motion: The summary panel settles with a subtle scale easing.
The final headline reveals and holds long enough to read.
scenes.audio: Music resolves gently; narration ends before the final visual hold.
scenes.transitionOut: Fade to the clean background over the final 250 ms.
